title: Jami' al-Bayan 'an Ta'wil Ay al-Qur'an
originalTitle: جامع البيان عن تأويل آي القرآن
transliteration: Jāmiʿ al-Bayān ʿan Taʾwīl Āy al-Qurʾān
author: al-tabari
attributionNote: The commentary is the author's own work; the reports and opinions it quotes are attributed within the text to their transmitters.
description: Al-Tabari's commentary proceeds verse by verse, gathering the readings of the Qur'an, the reports of the Companions and Successors, and the opinions of the early jurists before stating which reading he prefers and why. It is the earliest surviving commentary of this scope and the source from which much later tafsir quotes.
historicalContext: Composed in Baghdad over the last decades of al-Tabari's life, when the city was the centre of Qur'anic and legal scholarship. The work's method — transmission first, judgement second — became a model for Sunni tafsir, and its reports are still cited as evidence for how the earliest generations read individual verses.
availabilityNote: Streamed from Quran.com at read time: the Arabic commentary for one surah is requested and aligned ayah by ayah with this library's Qur'an passage index. Only the catalogue record, the surah outline and the passage index are held here.
